description:
Stitch AI-generated video scenes into a final video with transitions and music.
Supports portrait (9:16) and landscape (16:9), fade transitions, background music, and SpiderMedia upload.
Audio lane: voice_url adds a voiceover track (a URL you already have — no text-to-speech here), duck_music
lowers the music ~12 dB while the voice speaks, and captions burns word-level captions into the video.
- duck_music is OFF unless set, and the API refuses it (422) unless BOTH music_url and voice_url are given.
- Captions are drawn EXACTLY as you time them: nothing listens to the audio, so wrong timings render as wrong
  captions with no error. Timings from speech recognition are what was heard, not what the script says.
- A voice_url that cannot be downloaded, or has no audio stream, FAILS the job; it is never silently skipped.
Transitions: transition_frames 0 = hard cuts. A fade may not be longer than any scene it touches (frames at
30 fps) — the API answers 422 naming the scene and the largest fade that fits, before anything renders.
Loudness: loudness_target (LUFS, e.g. -14) normalises the finished mix; OFF unless set. The job result's
"loudness" block reports before/after and whether one constant gain was enough ("mode": "linear").
Output is H.264 yuv420p, BT.709, limited range.
This is a convenience wrapper for submit_job with type=spiderVideo.

captions.description: Word-level captions to burn into the video (1-20,000 tokens), drawn exactly as timed — the renderer does not measure the voice. A leading space in text starts a new word; a list with no leading spaces is shown one word per entry.

confidence.description: Optional ASR confidence 0-1 (unused by the renderer)

endMs.description: When the word ends, ms from the start of the video (>= startMs)

pageBreakAfter.description: Force a new caption page after this token

startMs.description: When the word starts, ms from the start of the video

text.description: Word (or sub-word token) to show, 1-200 chars

timestampMs.description: Optional ASR timestamp (unused by the renderer)

duck_music.description: Lower the music ~12 dB while the voiceover speaks (default: false). Requires BOTH music_url and voice_url — the API answers 422 otherwise.

loudness_target.description: Normalise the finished mix to this integrated loudness in LUFS (-30 to -10; -14 for social and streaming, -23 for EBU R128 broadcast), true peak capped at -1 dBTP. Off unless set.

preprocess.description: Auto-fix invalid formats with FFmpeg (default: false)

transition_frames.description: Fade between scenes in frames at 30 fps (default: 15 = 0.5 s; 0-60). 0 = hard cuts. Must not be longer than any scene it touches — the API answers 422 naming the scene.

voice_url.description: Voiceover audio URL (mp3, wav, m4a) — http(s) only, no TTS. Its own track, mixed over the music. A URL that fails to download or has no audio stream fails the job.

workspace.description: Tenant to target (cli_…). Omit to use the active/bound workspace. list_workspaces shows the options.

name: create_video
